selfPermitERC721(address,uint256,uint256.details: The `owner` is always msg.sender and the `spender` is always address(this).

params.deadline: A timestamp, the current blocktime must be less than or equal to this timestamp
params.r: Must produce valid secp256k1 signature from the holder along with `v` and `s`
params.s: Must produce valid secp256k1 signature from the holder along with `r` and `v`
params.token: The address of the token spent
params.tokenId: The token ID of the token spent
params.v: Must produce valid secp256k1 signature from the holder along with `r` and `s`

selfPermitERC721IfNecessary(address,uint.details: The `owner` is always msg.sender and the `spender` is always address(this). Please always use selfPermitERC721IfNecessary if possible prevent calls from failing due to a frontrun of a call to #selfPermitERC721. For details check https://github.com/pancakeswap/infinity-periphery/pull/62#discussion_r1675410282
